settings.heading: The scent
settings.content: Rose, jasmine, peony, and lilac in the opening, settling into warm sandalwood and soft musk. Familiar, but never predictable.

settings.heading: The bottle
settings.content: One 10 mL travel bottle in amber glass and gold. An atomised spray at one end, a rollerball at the other — a mist for the room, a roll for the wrist.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Filled in considered quantities, then sent the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days on an unopened bottle — write to the house and we'll sort it.
